name: Shubhash
storyText: Once working exhausting long hours as a driver away from his home, Shubhash, a devoted husband and father of two, sought a better life closer to his family. Guided by his brother, he joined the AC & Refrigeration course at SOL Keshav Puram under Samarth Bharat’s CDC Program in collaboration with DU colleges and Udhmodya Foundation. Through dedication and hands-on training, he quickly built strong technical skills. After completing the course, Shubhash secured placement with Bluestar India in Panipat earning ₹10,000/month — but more importantly, he now lives with his family. Today, he supports his loved ones and is saving to open his own AC service shop, proving that with the right skills and support, true transformation is possible.
impact: Earning ₹10,000/mo at Bluestar India • Future Shop Owner

name: Kavita
storyText: After years of financial struggle and limited income from a small setup, Kavita, a mother of two from Karol Bagh, found new direction through Samarth Bharat’s Beautician & Nail Art Course at Tank Road Center. With updated skills and renewed confidence, she rebranded her parlour as 'The Makeover Place' and now earns around ₹30,000/month. Beyond her personal success, she has also trained 7 other women from her locality, proving that upskilling not only transforms lives — it empowers entire communities.
impact: Earning ₹30,000/mo • Trained 7 other women in her locality

name: Badli Devi
storyText: After completing the Beautician Course at Samarth Bharat’s Chhawla Training Center (Jan–June 2024), Mrs. Badli Devi transformed her life through skill, confidence, and determination. Despite limited resources, she showed unwavering dedication throughout her training. Today, she successfully runs her own beauty parlour, earning around ₹16,000 per month. Her journey reflects the power of skill-based empowerment, and she now serves as an inspiration to many other women in her neighborhood seeking self-reliance.
impact: Earning ₹16,000/month • Self-reliant Salon Entrepreneur

name: Neelam
storyText: Neelam’s inspiring journey began with Batch 3 of the Beautician Course from Samarth Bharat in collaboration with Seva Bharti in Brahmpuri. Guided by her dedicated trainer, Ms. Kanchan, Neelam gained the professional skills and confidence needed to turn her passion into a livelihood. Today, she proudly runs her own beauty parlour and has taken on the role of a trainer herself, empowering other women by sharing the same knowledge that once changed her life. Her journey from a student to a mentor reflects the transformative power of community skill training.
impact: Student to Trainer • Mentoring & empowering women

name: Roopa Sharma
storyText: Roopa Sharma successfully completed a 3-month Beautician Course from Samarth Bharat in collaboration with Seva Bharti, where she gained essential skills in beauty and personal care. With her dedication and the guidance she received during training, Roopa secured a job in the beauty sector, where she now earns around ₹9,000–₹10,000 per month. Her journey is a powerful example of how focused vocational training opens the door to steady employment and self-reliance. Roopa’s success continues to inspire other women to take their first step toward a better future.
impact: Earning ₹9,000–₹10,000/month • Employed in Beauty Sector

name: Jyoti
storyText: Jyoti, a young woman with dreams but limited means, joined the 3-month Beautician Course from Samarth Bharat in collaboration with Seva Bharti hoping to build a better future. Despite facing personal and financial challenges, she remained committed to learning every day. Through the support of the trainers and her own dedication, Jyoti mastered the art of beauty and makeup. After completing the course, she secured a job earning ₹3,200 per month—a proud first step towards independence.
impact: First-time earner • Proud first step towards independence

name: Kavita (INA)
storyText: Kavita joined the 3-month Beautician Course at the Samarth Bharat INA Training Centre with the hope of building a better life for herself and her family. Coming from a background with limited opportunities, she worked hard every single day—learning, practicing, and growing her confidence. Her dedication paid off when she secured a job as a beautician in Lajpat Nagar, a dream she once thought was out of reach.
impact: Employed at Lajpat Nagar Salon • Financial Independence

name: Deepansha
companyOrCenter: Looks Salon (Dwarka Pacific Mall) / Raghubir Nagar
storyText: Deepansha, a resident of Paharganj, completed a three-month Beautician Course at Samarth Bharat’s Raghubir Nagar Centre under the expert guidance of Ms. Ranjita. With limited prior knowledge, the clear and detailed instruction helped her gain essential skills and confidence. After earning her certification from KVIC, she was selected for an internship at Looks Salon’s Dwarka Pacific Mall branch, where she now works as a Beauty Assistant Intern with a monthly stipend of ₹9,000. Grateful to Samarth Bharat and her trainer, Deepansha continues to grow professionally.
impact: Stipend ₹9,000/mo at Looks Salon • KVIC Certified

name: Sapna Sharma
storyText: Sapna Sharma, a trainee from Samarth Bharat’s Brahmpuri Centre, is now proudly running her own beauty parlour, a dream she achieved through the skills and confidence gained during her training. She expresses heartfelt gratitude to her trainer, Ms. Kanchan Verma, for her patient and dedicated guidance, which played a key role in Sapna’s journey toward self-reliance. Grateful to the entire Samarth Bharat team for their support and encouragement, Sapna credits the organization for making her success possible.
impact: Independent Salon Owner • Self-reliant Entrepreneur

name: Savitri & Sudha
storyText: Savitri and Sudha were part of the first batch of the Beautician Course at Samarth Bharat’s Brahmpuri Training Centre. After successfully completing their training, the duo decided to take a bold step toward self-employment by opening their own beauty parlour together. They named it 'Soumya Beauty Parlour', and it was officially inaugurated in Sudamapuri, East Delhi. Before starting their venture, both of them gained hands-on experience by working at local parlours. Once confident in their skills, they launched their own salon, showing the true power of collaborative women entrepreneurship.
impact: Co-founded Soumya Beauty Parlour • Women Entrepreneurship

name: Mangal Singh
storyText: Mangal Singh, a resident of Trilokpuri, ran a small shop called Tanishka Electricals handling basic electrical repair work. Hit hard by the COVID-19 pandemic, his shop came to a standstill and work opportunities disappeared almost overnight. During this distress, Mangal enrolled in the AC and Refrigeration Course at the New Ashok Nagar Training Centre. After completing the course, Mangal began offering AC and refrigerator repair services at his shop and clients' homes. As demand soared, he brought on board three fellow trainees—Tejpal, Deepak, and Anil. Today, Mangal earns between ₹30,000 to ₹40,000 per month, and each team member earns ₹20,000 to ₹25,000 monthly.
impact: Earning ₹30,000–₹40,000/mo • Employing 3 fellow trainees

name: Basant Kumar
storyText: Basant Kumar, a resident of Trilokpuri, was among the many who faced deep uncertainty after the COVID-19 pandemic disrupted livelihoods. With no specialized skills and no stable job, Basant struggled to find meaningful work. Seeing a ray of hope, Basant enrolled at the New Ashok Nagar Training Centre and completed the AC and Refrigeration Course. To ensure reliability and quality, he teamed up with fellow trainee Ketan. Their honest and skilled work won regular clients. Today, Basant earns between ₹30,000 to ₹40,000 per month—a dramatic turnaround from where he started.
impact: Earning ₹30,000–₹40,000/month • High-demand Technician

name: Usha
companyOrCenter: Paharganj / Tank Road, Karol Bagh Centre
storyText: Living in Paharganj with her family of six, Usha struggled to manage household expenses on her husband’s single income. Determined to support her family, she enrolled in Samarth Bharat’s Beautician Course at Tank Road, Karol Bagh. With hands-on training and expert guidance, she gained the skills and confidence needed to enter the beauty industry. After working in parlours to learn business operations, Usha eventually opened her own venture — New Shine Beauty Parlour. Today, she earns a steady income, runs a successful business, and inspires her daughters to become self-reliant.
impact: Homemaker to Business Owner • New Shine Beauty Parlour

name: Hari Om
storyText: Once working as a Zomato delivery rider in Chirag Delhi, Hari Om chose not to give up on his dreams. With limited resources but strong determination, he enrolled in a 2-month AC & Fridge Repair course at Samarth Bharat’s Malviya Nagar Center. His dedication paid off — today, he is proudly employed at LG Electronics, one of India’s leading consumer appliance brands. Hari Om’s journey reflects the core belief of Samarth Bharat: with the right skills and guidance, life transformation is possible.
impact: Delivery Rider to Corporate Technician at LG Electronics

name: Khushboo
storyText: Khushboo, a resident of Sangam Vihar, Delhi, chose a path that few women take — working in the AC and RO repair field. She completed her training from Samarth Bharat’s Sangam Vihar Center, where she learned both technical skills and hands-on fieldwork. In the beginning, people questioned her decision, but Khushboo stayed focused and turned every challenge into an opportunity. With support from her trainers and her own dedication, she became a skilled and confident technician. Today, Khushboo works independently and earns ₹18,000 per month with a loyal customer base who regularly call her for service.
impact: Earning ₹18,000/mo • Breaking stereotypes in technical repair

name: Barkha
storyText: Barkha successfully completed the 3-month Beautician Course from Samarth Bharat in collaboration with Seva Bharti in Malviya Nagar, where she gained professional training in beauty and grooming. Upon completion, she received a certificate from the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) — a proud milestone in her journey. Today, Barkha is earning ₹8,000–₹10,000 per month by becoming a freelancer offering home beauty services to clients in her area. Her hard work, combined with the training, enabled her to achieve financial independence.
impact: Earning ₹8,000–₹10,000/month • KVIC Certified Freelancer

name: Rachna
storyText: Rachna, a trainee from Samarth Bharat’s Brahmpuri Centre, proudly shares how the beauty and parlour training she received became a turning point in her life. With the support of her trainer, Ms. Kanchan Verma, who patiently taught her even the basics, Rachna gained the skills and confidence needed to pursue her dream in the beauty industry. The training not only equipped her with knowledge but also led to a good job opportunity, helping her become financially independent.
impact: Financially independent • Professional Salon Career

name: Radha
storyText: Radha, a resident of Lajpat Nagar, always dreamed of becoming self-reliant and skilled. She found her path when she enrolled in the Beautician Course offered by Samarth Bharat. With determination and the right guidance, Radha learned not just beauty techniques, but also how to connect with clients professionally. Today, she provides beautician services through online platforms and phone calls, reaching clients right from her neighborhood. Her confidence has grown, and she’s earning ₹10,000–₹12,000 per month through freelance services.
impact: Earning ₹10,000–₹12,000/month • On-demand Beauty Services

name: Sangeeta
storyText: Sangeeta, a resident of Karawal Nagar, came across the Beautician Course offered by Samarth Bharat at the Brahmpuri Centre through an online platform. With little prior knowledge of the beauty field, she enrolled and began a transformative three-month journey under the guidance of trainer Ms. Kanchan Verma. The practical training helped her master essential skills. Remarkably, even before completing the course, she secured a job at the reputed Looks Salon—an opportunity she had never imagined. Sangeeta now feels confident, capable, and financially secure.
impact: Recruited at Looks Salon before course completion

name: Riya
companyOrCenter: Looks Salon (Pacific Mall, Subhash Nagar) / Raghubir Nagar
storyText: Riya, a resident of Paharganj, completed a three-month Beautician Course at Samarth Bharat’s Raghubir Nagar Centre under the expert guidance of trainer Ms. Ranjita. After receiving certification from KVIC, Riya was selected for a three-month internship as a Beauty Assistant at Looks Salon in Subhash Nagar’s Pacific Mall, earning a monthly stipend of ₹9,000. As she gains hands-on experience, her confidence continues to grow, and she is advancing toward a permanent position with salary prospects of ₹20,000–₹25,000.
impact: Stipend ₹9,000/mo at Looks Salon • Future ₹25k Role

name: Devaraj Singh
storyText: Devaraj Singh, once a small business owner, saw his life turn upside down during the COVID-19 pandemic when his business halted and financial stability crumbled. Just when things seemed hopeless, a friend told him about Samarth Bharat and the vocational courses offered at their centers. Motivated to rebuild his life, Devaraj enrolled in the AC and Refrigeration Course at the New Ashok Nagar Training Centre. With renewed hope and skills in hand, Devaraj applied for a technician position at UrbanClap (now Urban Company). To his great relief, he was selected in the very first interview. Today, Devaraj is thriving—earning ₹50,000 to ₹60,000 per month, allowing him to support his family with immense pride and stability.
impact: Earning ₹50,000 to ₹60,000/month at Urban Company

name: Rajkumar
companyOrCenter: Rafiar Air Conditioning / New Ashok Nagar Centre
storyText: Rajkumar, a resident of Ashok Nagar, comes from a humble background. Due to financial difficulties in his family, he was unable to pursue higher education. Eager to support his family, Rajkumar began searching for work—but was unable to find a stable job. One day, while walking down the street, Rajkumar noticed a Samarth Bharat signboard offering training in AC and Refrigerator Repair. Finding it practical and affordable, he enrolled. Every topic was taught thoroughly with practical training. After completing the course, Rajkumar was hired by Rafiar Air Conditioning, where he now works as a technician earning ₹10,000 per month, finding dignity and direction in his work.
impact: Earning ₹10,000/month at Rafiar Air Conditioning

name: Sonu
storyText: Sonu had always dreamed of working in the finance sector, but without proper training or experience, that dream felt distant. Coming from a modest background, he knew he needed practical technical skills. His turning point came when he enrolled in the Tally and GST Course offered by Samarth Bharat. Determined to create a better future, Sonu committed himself fully to learning—grasping everything from accounting fundamentals to practical GST applications. The course gave him confidence. After completing the training, Sonu was selected for a job at Perfect Finance Company in Green Park—his proud first step into the corporate world.
impact: Selected at Perfect Finance Company, Green Park • GST & Tally

name: Pooja Yadav
storyText: Pooja Yadav, a determined learner from Samarth Bharat’s Sangam Vihar Centre, successfully completed the GST and Tally course, which laid the foundation for her career in accounting. After her training, she was selected for a role as an Accountant Assistant Trainee at Child and Property, where she continues to enhance her skills through practical on-the-job experience. This opportunity has made her financially independent, with a monthly earning of ₹10,000. Pooja expresses deep gratitude to Samarth Bharat for giving her the confidence, knowledge, and direction to take this important step toward a brighter future.
impact: Earning ₹10,000/month • Accountant Assistant Trainee
